# These clauses stay `pending` in docs/index.md — see branchLeft/workspace#1367
# and #1365. Phase 1a ships the reader only; the owner sets the real number
# and Phase 2 flips the gate class in its own reviewed PR. Until then every
# finding these checks emit reports as advisory, never as a failure, so no
# consuming repo can go red from a number nobody has chosen yet.
# A `#provisional` reason is a signal check-clause-index.sh reads: it is what
# lets a pending clause be named by a real script here without that reading as
# the usual "implemented but the row was never updated" rot.
